status: approved and implemented in Part 6 on 2026-10-05
connection_requirements: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON before any transaction on every connection
Parameterized queries; explicit transactions for mutations

notes: Case-sensitive username; existing Argon2 hashes and user IDs remain unchanged.

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
notes: Unique user_id enforces at most one board per user; initialization supplies one for every user.
Increment revision once per successful manual mutation or AI batch.

columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((id = 'col-backlog' AND position = 0) OR (id = 'col-discovery' AND position = 1) OR (id = 'col-progress' AND position = 2) OR (id = 'col-review' AND position = 3) OR (id = 'col-done' AND position = 4))
notes: Column IDs are stable within a board and shared across boards for frontend compatibility.
Exactly five columns is an initialization/service invariant; database constraints enforce only allowed ID/position pairs and uniqueness.
Only title can be updated by the API.

columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (board_id, column_id) REFERENCES columns(board_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
notes: Backend-generated UUID4 string; immutable id and board_id.
Position is zero-based within a column; contiguous unique positions are maintained by service transactions, not a UNIQUE constraint.
Each row references exactly one existing column on its own board.

initialization.existing_accounts: Keep all existing users, IDs, usernames and password hashes.
initialization.existing_users: Create a missing board with all five columns and eight copied demo cards in one transaction per user.
initialization.new_registration: Insert account, board, columns and eight copied demo cards in the same transaction.
initialization.seed_source: Copy titles/details and column membership from frontend/src/lib/kanban.ts initialData; generate fresh card UUIDs for each board.
initialization.repeat_start: Skip seeding if a board already exists; never reinsert deleted cards or overwrite names/order.
initialization.schema_version: Set PRAGMA user_version = 1 after successful additive initialization; preserve users table. Future changes use explicit versioned migrations.

application_invariants: Acting user comes from current_user; resolve users.id from its username.
Every card lookup and mutation includes the authenticated board_id.
Never expose an API for changing board ownership or creating/deleting/reordering columns.
Titles are stripped of surrounding whitespace and validated before SQL; details may be empty.
Card positions must be exactly 0..n-1 within each column after every committed mutation.
A failed operation rolls back its entire transaction, including revision updates.

api_board_shape.columns: Ordered by position; return id,title,cardIds ordered by card position.
api_board_shape.cards: Object keyed by card UUID with id,title,details.
api_board_shape.revision: Additional integer for detecting stale writes; never include password hashes.
